The 1969 Pontiac GTO needs to bulk up before breaking; the team modifies the chassis and installs new fuel lines.

Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look with a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different; on this episode, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

The boys finally lay down some paint on their '69 GTO.

Tommy and Joel install a new third pedal and show you the dos and don'ts on how to bleed the transmission.

description:

The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU on Project Henchman.

description:

GTO gets new exhaust and wheels, plus learn how to adjust wheel offset.

title: Detroit Muscle
description:

We upgrade a '69 GTO with new glass, power windows, and a complete interior makeover.

title: Detroit Muscle
description:

The day has finally come as the guys finish up their 1969 GTO, Project Henchman, and take it on its first drive; they add a few finishing touches and show you how to carefully install a spoiler on finished paint.

title: Engine Power
description:
S12 E10 — 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 1
We build a big-inch, pump-gas Chevy W-Series monster from an aluminum block!

title: Engine Power
description:
S12 E11 — 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
Continuing the buildup of a 509ci W-Series engine and getting it ready to hit the engine dyno; wrapping up this vintage-looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before seeing how much power it makes on the dyno.

title: Under the Hood
description:
S01 E03 — Jason Mode - Dark Matters C10
Dark Matters, Jason Mode's '68 C10, is a subtly modded, powerful truck with killer black and red style.

title: Truck Tech
description:

Converting a classic Chevy C10 into a street bruiser; swapping in a Duramax diesel with Allison 6 speed automatic.

title: Truck Tech
description:

De-laminated paint repair, a cowl hood, weld-in roll pan and new front end treatment for C-10 with Duramax diesel.

title: Truck Tech
description:

How to box a Chevy 1500 frame for the extra power and torque of a modern Duramax diesel V8 engine.

title: Truck Tech
description:
S02 E19 — NightTrain: Suspension
Team drops and levels Duramax diesel Chevy 1500 with 2/4 suspension kit and swaps out anemic factory 10 bolt rear.

title: Truck Tech
description:

Fabricating intercooler plumbing, custom fuel lines and custom exhaust to fire up the Duramax diesel.

title: Truck Tech
description:

Firing an EcoBoost in bare chassis; plumb a Duramax cooling system.

title: Truck Tech
description:
S03 E04 — NighTrain Payoff & Budget Silverado
Diesel NighTrain hits the strip for a payoff, and tune our Silverado Project White Noize.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E03 — TrashHawk
The guys visit DBR Performance and their first chance ever to drive a Jeep TrackHawk, which inspires a plan of their own: to turn an old Wagoneer into a screaming street monster.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E04 — Suspension of Jeep Belief
The Jeep Trackhawk gets the upgraded axles, brakes and suspension it will need to handle 707 horses; it will become a ride like it's never been before.

title: Engine Power
description:
S08 E08 — Supercharged 427 LSX
Team converts 427 LSX engine from naturally aspirated to supercharged, aiming for significant horsepower boost.
